description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee chain founded in Vancouver in 1992, now operating locally owned and operated franchise locations across Canada. The Davie Street location serves handcrafted espresso drinks, organic teas, protein shakes, and a full food menu ranging from croissants and breakfast sandwiches to samosas. Outdoor seating and a central West End location make it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists riding the Seawall or nearby routes.
